mapper.sql: id, user_id, quota_type, quota_limit, alert_threshold, is_enabled, status, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_user_token_quota WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY quota_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_user_token_quota (user_id, quota_type, quota_limit, alert_threshold, is_enabled, status, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{quotaType}, #{quotaLimit}, #{alertThreshold}, #{isEnabled}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_user_token_quota SET quota_limit = #{quotaLimit}, alert_threshold = #{alertThreshold}, is_enabled = #{isEnabled}, status = #{status}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_user_token_quota SET is_enabled = #{isEnabled}, status = CASE WHEN #{isEnabled} = 1 THEN 'normal' ELSE 'disabled' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS totalUsers, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabledCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'exceeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS exceededCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN is_enabled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabledCount FROM ai_user_token_quota
